dhampir/dhampir_ability_scores.json.description: Dhampirs are fast and seductive, but their mortal vigor is impeded.
dhampir/dhampir_ability_scores.json.name: +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, -2 Constitution

dhampir/dhampir_languages.json.description: Dhampirs begin play speaking Common. Dhampirs with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want (except secret languages, such as Druidic).
dhampir/dhampir_languages.json.name: Languages

automatic_trait_grants: Universal Monster Rule ~ Negative Energy Affinity
dhampir/dhampir_negative_energy_affinity.description: Though they're living creatures, dhampirs react to positive and negative energy as if they were undead; positive energy harms them, and negative energy heals them.
dhampir/dhampir_negative_energy_affinity.name: Negative Energy Affinity

dhampir/dhampir_resist_level_drain.json.description: A dhampir takes no penalties from energy drain effects, though he can still be killed if he accrues more negative levels then he has Hit Dice. After 24 hours, any negative levels a dhampir takes are removed without the need for an additional saving throw.
dhampir/dhampir_resist_level_drain.json.name: Resist Level Drain

dhampir/dhampir_size.json.description: Dhampirs are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
dhampir/dhampir_size.json.name: Medium

dhampir/dhampir_skilled.json.description: Dhampirs gain a +2 racial bonus on Bluff and Perception checks.
dhampir/dhampir_skilled.json.name: Manipulative

dhampir/dhampir_speed.json.description: Dhampirs have a base speed of 30 feet.
dhampir/dhampir_speed.json.name: Normal Speed

dhampir/dhampir_spell_like_ability.json.description: A dhampir can use detect undead three times per day as a spell-like ability (with a caster level equal to the dhampir's character level).
dhampir/dhampir_spell_like_ability.json.name: Spell-Like Ability

dhampir/dhampir_type.json.description: Dhampirs are humanoids with the dhampir subtype.
dhampir/dhampir_type.json.name: Dhampir

dhampir/dhampir_undead_resistance.json.description: Dhampirs gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against disease and mind-affecting effects.
dhampir/dhampir_undead_resistance.json.name: Undead Resistance

dhampir/dhampir_vision.json.description: Dhampirs get low-light vision and darkvision with a range of 60 feet.
dhampir/dhampir_vision.json.name: Senses

dhampir/dhampir_weakness.json.description: Dhampirs are dazzled in areas of bright sunlight or within the radius of a daylight spell.
dhampir/dhampir_weakness.json.name: Light Sensitivity

fetchling/fetchling_ability_scores.json.description: Fetchlings are quick and forceful, but often strange and easily distracted by errant thoughts.
fetchling/fetchling_ability_scores.json.name: +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, -2 Wisdom

fetchling/fetchling_languages.json.description: Fetchlings begin play speaking Common. Fetchlings with a high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Aklo, Aquan, Auran, Draconic, D'ziriak (understanding only, cannot speak), Ignan, Terran, and any regional human tongue.
fetchling/fetchling_languages.json.name: Languages

fetchling/fetchling_low_light_vision.jso.description: Fetchlings can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
fetchling/fetchling_low_light_vision.jso.name: Low-Light Vision

fetchling/fetchling_shadow_blending.json.description: Attacks against a fetchling in dim light have a 50% miss chance instead of the normal 20% miss chance. This ability does not grant total concealment; it just increases the miss chance.
fetchling/fetchling_shadow_blending.json.name: Shadow Blending

fetchling/fetchling_shadowy_resistance.j.description: Fetchlings have cold resistance 5 and electricity resistance 5.
fetchling/fetchling_shadowy_resistance.j.name: Shadowy Resistance

fetchling/fetchling_size.json.description: Fetchlings are Medium creatures and receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
fetchling/fetchling_size.json.name: Medium

fetchling/fetchling_skilled.json.description: Fetchlings have a +2 racial bonus on Knowledge (planes) and Stealth checks.
fetchling/fetchling_skilled.json.name: Skilled

fetchling/fetchling_speed.json.description: Fetchlings have a base speed of 30 feet.
fetchling/fetchling_speed.json.name: Normal Speed

automatic_trait_grants: Racial SLA ~ Plane Shift (self only/to Shadow or Material Plane)
fetchling/fetchling_spell_like_abilities.description: A fetchling can use disguise self once per day as a spell-like ability. He can assume the form of any humanoid creature using this spell-like ability. When a fetchling reaches character 9th level in any combination of classes, he gains shadow walk (self only) as a spell-like ability usable once per day, and at 13th level, he gains plane shift (self only, to the Shadow Plane or the Material Plane only) usable once per day. A fetchling's caster level for these abilities is equal to his character level.
fetchling/fetchling_spell_like_abilities.name: Spell-Like Abilities

fetchling/fetchling_type.json.description: Fetchlings are outsiders with the native subtype.
fetchling/fetchling_type.json.name: Native Outsider

fetchling/fetchling_vision.json.description: Fetchlings can see in the dark up to 60 feet.
fetchling/fetchling_vision.json.name: Darkvision

grippli/grippli_ability_scores.json.description: Gripplis are nimble and alert, but spindly.
grippli/grippli_ability_scores.json.name: +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, -2 Strength

grippli/grippli_camouflage.json.description: Gripplis receive a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks in marshes and forested areas.
grippli/grippli_camouflage.json.name: Camouflage

grippli/grippli_languages.json.description: Gripplis begin play speaking Common and Grippli. Gripplis with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Boggard, Draconic, Elven, Gnome, Goblin, and Sylvan.
grippli/grippli_languages.json.name: Languages

grippli/grippli_natural_climber.json.description: Gripplis have a climb speed of 20 feet.
grippli/grippli_natural_climber.json.name: Natural Climber

grippli/grippli_size.json.description: Gripplis are Small creatures and gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls,a -1 penalty on combat maneuver checks and to their Combat Maneuver Defense, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.
grippli/grippli_size.json.name: Small

grippli/grippli_speed.json.description: Gripplis have a base speed of 30 feet.
grippli/grippli_speed.json.name: Normal Speed

grippli/grippli_swamp_stride.json.description: A grippli can move through difficult terrain at its normal speed while within a swamp. Magically altered terrain affects a grippli normally.
grippli/grippli_swamp_stride.json.name: Swamp Stride

grippli/grippli_type.json.description: Gripplis are humanoids with the grippli subtype.
grippli/grippli_type.json.name: Grippli

grippli/grippli_vision.json.description: Gripplis can see in the dark up to 60 feet.
grippli/grippli_vision.json.name: Darkvision

ifrit/ifrit_ability_scores.json.name: +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, -2 Wisdom

ifrit/ifrit_fire_affinity.json.description: Ifrit sorcerers with the elemental (fire) bloodline treat their Charisma scores as 2 points higher for the purposes of all sorcerer spells and class abilities. Ifrit spellcasters with the Fire domain use their domain powers and spells at +1 caster level.

ifrit/ifrit_languages.json.name: Languages

ifrit/ifrit_size.json.description: Ifrits are Medium creatures and receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
ifrit/ifrit_size.json.name: Medium

ifrit/ifrit_speed.json.description: Ifrits have a base speed of 30 feet.
ifrit/ifrit_speed.json.name: Normal Speed

ifrit/ifrit_spell_like_ability.json.description: Ifrits can use burning hands 1/day as a spell-like ability (caster level equals the ifrit’s character level).
ifrit/ifrit_spell_like_ability.json.name: Spell-Like Ability

ifrit/ifrit_type.json.description: Ifrits are outsiders with the native subtype.
ifrit/ifrit_type.json.name: Native Outsider

ifrit/ifrit_vision.json.description: Ifrits can see in the dark up to 60 feet.
ifrit/ifrit_vision.json.name: Darkvision
